maps-desc: Waxay oggolaanaysaa ku-dhexgelinta khariidado firfircoon bogagga wiki-ga iyadoo la adeegsanayo Google Maps ama Leaflet. Waxay leedahay tifaftire muuqaal ah, si ikhtiyaari ah ayay ula midoobi kartaa Semantic MediaWiki, waxay taageertaa GeoJSON waxayna ku dartaa awoodaha geocoding.
maps-tracking-category: Bogag leh khariidad ay soo bandhigtay kordhinta Maps
maps-kml-parsing-failed: Ku guuldarraystay turjumaadda hal ama in ka badan oo faylal KML ah. Caadi ahaan tani waxay dhacdaa sababo la xiriira guuldarro soo-dejin ama XML khaldan.
maps-layerdef-invalid: {{PLURAL:$1|Qeexitaan aan sax ahayn|Qeexitaanno aan sax ahayn}}
maps-layerdef-wrong-namespace: Qeexitaannada lakabku waxay ku ansax yihiin oo keliya bogagga ku jira meel magaca "$1"
maps-layerdef-equal-layer-name: Magacyada lakabyadu waa inay ahaadaan kuwo gaar ah isla bogga lakabka gudaheeda. "$1" waxaa horay u isticmaalaya lakab kale.
maps-layerpage-nousage: Ma jiro wax bog ah oo hadda isticmaalaya lakabkan.
validation-error-invalid-layer: Hal beegga "$1" waa inuu noqdaa lakab ansax ah.
validation-error-invalid-layers: Halbeegga "$1" waa inuu noqdaa hal ama in ka badan oo lakabyo ansax ah.
validation-error-no-non-numeric: Halbeegga "$1" waa inuu noqdaa xarfo aan tiro ahayn.
validation-error-no-non-numerics: Halbeegga "$1" waa inuu noqdaa hal ama in ka badan oo xarfo aan tiro ahayn.
maps-coordinates-description: Qabashada falanqeeye si loo qaabeeyo isku duwayaasha, laga bilaabo iyo ilaa mid kasta oo ka mid ah qaabab la taageeray.
maps-displaymap-description: Soo bandhig khariidado juqraafiyeed oo aan lahayn wax calaamadeeyayaal ay wiki-gu qeexday.
maps-distance-description: U beddel masaafad la adeegsanayo halbeeg la taageeray una dhig dhiggeeda iyadoo la adeegsanayo halbeeg kale.
maps-finddestination-description: Raadi meel loo socdo iyadoo la adeegsanayo meel bilow ah (oo ku jiri karta mid kasta oo ka mid ah qaababka la taageeray), jiho bilow ah iyo masaafad.
maps-geocode-description: Waxay awood u siisaa geocoding-ka cinwaannada, si kale haddii loo dhigo, u beddelidda goobaha ay dadku akhrin karaan una beddelidda kooxo isku-duwayaal ah. Waxaa jira taageero adeegyo geocoding oo kala duwan, kuwaas oo aan lagu khaldin adeegyada khariidaynta.
maps-geodistance-description: Xisaabi masaafadda juqraafiyeed ee u dhexeysa laba dhibcood, laga bilaabo iyo ilaa mid kasta oo ka mid ah qaababka la taageeray.
maps-mapsdoc-description: Soo bandhig jadwal leh halbeegyada adeeg khariidayneed oo la cayimay, oo ay weheliyaan qiimayaashooda caadiga ah iyo sharraxaadahooda.
maps-layerdefinition-description: Waxay qeexaysaa lakab gaar ah oo lagu soo bandhigi karo hawlaha kale ee Khariidadda.
maps-mapsdoc-par-service: Adeegga khariidaynta ee loo soo bandhigayo dukumentiyada halbeegga.
maps-mapsdoc-par-language: Luuqadda lagu soo bandhigayo dukumentiga. Haddii aan la heli karin turjumaad noocaas ah, waxaa halkii laga isticmaali doonaa Ingiriisiga.
maps-coordinates-par-location: Isku duwayaasha aad rabto inaad qaabayso.
maps-coordinates-par-directional: Waxay tilmaamaysaa in isku-duwayaasha loo soo saaro si jihaysan ama aan loo saarin.
maps-par-scrollwheelzoom: Waxay tilmaamaysaa in rogista jiirka la hawlgeliyo ama aan la hawlgelin.
maps-distance-par-distance: Masaafadda loo beddelayo dhiggeeda iyadoo la adeegsanayo halbeeg cayiman.
maps-distance-par-decimals: Tirada ugu badan ee jajabyada tobanle ee lagu isticmaali karo qiimaha ka dhasha.
maps-finddestination-par-format: Qaabka lagu soo saarayo meesha loo socdo.
maps-finddestination-par-directional: Waxay tilmaamaysaa in qaabka meesha loo socdo uu noqdo mid jihaysan ama aan ahayn.
maps-geocode-par-location: Cinwaanka aad rabto in la geocode-gareeyo.
maps-geocode-par-directional: Waxay tilmaamaysaa in isku-duwayaasha loo soo saaro si jihaysan ama aan loo saarin.
maps-geodistance-par-location1: Dhibicda koowaad ee ku jirta xirmada si loo xisaabiyo masaafadda u dhexeysa.
maps-geodistance-par-location2: Dhibicda labaad ee ku jirta xirmada si loo xisaabiyo masaafadda u dhexeysa.
maps-geodistance-par-decimals: Tirada ugu badan ee jajabyada tobanle ee lagu isticmaali karo qiimaha ka dhasha.
maps-displaymap-par-mappingservice: Waxay oggolaanaysaa dejinta adeegga khariidaynta ee loo isticmaali doono abuurista khariidadda.
maps-displaymap-par-coordinates: Hal ama in ka badan oo goobo ah oo lagu soo bandhigayo khariidadda. Waxaa lagu tilmaami doonaa calaamadeeye.
maps-displaymap-par-visitedicon: Magaca faylka sawirka loo adeegsanayo astaamaha calaamadeeyayaasha ka dib marka calaamadeeyayaashii asalka ahaa la gujiyo
maps-displaymap-par-zoom:
Waxay oggolaanaysaa dejinta heerka soo-dhoweynta ee khariidadda.
Marka aan la bixin oo ay khariidadda ku jiraan calaamadeeyayaal badan, waxaa la qaadan doonaa soo-dhoweynta ugu habboon, ee ma aha tan caadiga ah ee la habayn karo.
maps-displaymap-par-centre:
Waxay oggolaanaysaa dejinta isku-duwayaasha bartamaha khariidadda ee display_point(s).
Waxay aqbashaa cinwaanno iyo isku-duwayaal labadaba.
Marka astaantan aan la bixin, khariidaddu waxay iskeed ugu dhex toosin doontaa calaamadeeyaha la bixiyay, ama inta u dhexeysa calaamadeeyayaasha la bixiyay.
maps-displaymap-par-title:
Waxay oggolaanaysaa dejinta qoraal lagu soo bandhigi doono daaqadaha soo-baxa ee dhammaan calaamadeeyayaasha aan lahayn cinwaan gaar ah.
Marka lala isticmaalo label, cinwaanku wuxuu noqonayaa mid dhumuc leh oo hoosta laga xarriiqay.
maps-displaymap-par-label: Waxay oggolaanaysaa dejinta qoraal lagu soo bandhigi doono daaqadaha soo baxa ee dhammaan calaamadeeyayaasha aan lahayn calaamad gaar ah.
maps-displaymap-par-icon: Waxay oggolaanaysaa dejinta astaanta loo adeegsanayo dhammaan calaamadeeyayaasha.
maps-displaymap-par-copycoords: Ku muuji wada-hadal marka la gujiyo calaamadeeye, kaas oo laga koobi karo isku duwayaashiisa.
maps-displaymap-par-minzoom: Heerka ugu hooseeya ee soo dhoweynta.
maps-displaymap-par-static: Ka dhig khariidadda mid aan dhaqaaqin
maps-displaymap-par-geojson: Hal ama in ka badan oo bogag ama URL-yo ah oo ay ku jiraan xogta GeoJSON, oo lagu kala saaray semicolon
maps-fullscreen-button-tooltip: U eeg khariidadda sidii shaashad buuxda ama ku dhexnjirta.

maps-geocoder-not-available: Astaanta geocode-gareynta ee Maps lama heli karo. Goobtaada lama koodhka juqraafiyeed karayo.
maps-leaflet-par-defzoom: Waxay oggolaanaysaa dejinta heerka caadiga ah ee soo dhoweynta khariidadda.
maps-leaflet-par-layers: Lakabyada laga heli doono xulaha lakabyada. Lakabka ugu horreeya ayaa la soo bandhigi doonaa marka khariidaddu soo degto.
maps-leaflet-par-image-layers: Lakabyada salka ah ee sawirka. Lakabka ugu horreeya ayaa loo soo bandhigi doonaa si caadi ah. Haddii sawirro la cayimo, waxaa loo adeegsan doonaa halkii laga isticmaali lahaa lakabyada khariidadda caadiga ah.
maps-leaflet-par-layers-dark: Lakabyada laga heli doono xulaha lakabyada marka habka mugdiga ah la hawlgeliyo. Lakabka ugu horreeya ayaa la soo bandhigi doonaa marka khariidadda soo degto.
maps-leaflet-par-overlaylayers: Lakabyada dul saarka ee la soo bandhigi doono marka khariidaddu soo degto.
maps-leaflet-par-maxclusterradius: Gacan qabsiga ugu badan ee kooxdu ka dabooli doonto calaamadda dhexe (oo lagu cabbirayo pixels).
maps-leaflet-par-clusterspiderfy: Marka aad gujiso koox ku jirta heerka ugu hooseeya ee soo dhoweynta, waxaan u kala furfurnaa si aad u arki karto dhammaan calaamadihiisa.
maps-leaflet-par-clicktarget: Marka aad gujiso khariidadda waxaa laguu diri doonaa URL-kan. %lat% waxaa lagu beddeli doonaa loolka, halka %long% lagu beddeli doono dhigaha.
maps_click_to_activate: Guji si aad u hawlgeliso khariidadda
maps-par-mappingservice: Waxay oggolaanaysaa dejinta adeegga khariidaynta ee loo adeegsan doono samaynta khariidadda.
maps-par-resizable: Waxay ka dhigaysaa khariidadda mid cabbirkeeda la beddeli karo iyadoo laga jiidayo geeskeeda hoose ee midig.
maps-par-searchmarkers: Waxay oggolaanaysaa in laga raadiyo calaamado gaar ah iyada oo loo marayo goob ku dhex jirta khariidadda.
maps-par-zoom: Heerka soo dhoweynta ee khariidadda. Khariidadaha leh calaamado, tani waxay si caadi ah ugu dejin doontaa heerka ugu dhow ee soo-dhoweynta oo weli muujinaya dhammaan calaamadaha.
maps-par-width: Waxay oggolaanaysaa dejinta ballaca khariidadda. Sida caadiga ah pixels ayaa loo qaadan doonaa inuu yahay halbeegga, laakiin si cad ayaad u cayimi kartaa mid ka mid ah halbeegyadan: px, ex, em, %.
maps-par-height: Waxay oggolaanaysaa dejinta dhererka khariidadda. Sida caadiga ah pixels ayaa loo qaadan doonaa inuu yahay halbeegga, laakiin si cad ayaad u cayimi kartaa mid ka mid ah halbeegyadan: px, ex, em.
maps-par-centre: Goobta ay tahay in bartamaha khariidadda lagu saleeyo
maps-par-mylocationzoom: Heerka soo dhoweynta ee loo tagayo marka goobta isticmaalaha la shido
maps-par-enable-mylocationfollow: Si joogto ah khariidadda ugu xaji goobta isticmaalaha
maps-par-kml: Faylasha KML ee lagu shubayo khariidadda.
maps-par-markercluster: Waxay oggolaanaysaa in calaamado badan oo isu dhow lagu mideeyo hal calaamad
maps-googlemaps3-incompatbrowser: Barowsarkaagu lama jaanqaadayo Google Maps v3.
maps-googlemaps3-par-imageoverlays: Waxay oggolaanaysaa in sawir lagu daro oo lagu muujiyo goobta lagu cayimay ee khariidadda.
maps-googlemaps3-par-type: Nooca khariidadda ee marka hore la soo bandhigayo.
maps-googlemaps3-par-types: Noocyada khariidadda ee laga heli karo xakamaynta nooca khariidadda.
maps-googlemaps3-par-layers: Lakabyo gaar ah oo lagu shubayo khariidadda.
maps-googlemaps3-par-autoinfowindows: Si otomaatig ah u fur dhammaan daaqadaha macluumaadka marka boggu soo dhammeeyo rarashada.
maps-googlemaps3-par-gkml: Faylasha KML ee Google martigeliso oo lagu shubayo khariidadda.

maps-googlemaps3-par-clustergridsize: Cabbirka shabakadda kooxeed ee pikisello ahaan.
maps-par-clustermaxzoom: Heerka ugu sarreeya ee soo dhoweynta ay kooxuhu ka jiri karaan.
maps-par-clusterzoomonclick: In gujinta kooxdu ay si caadi ah ugu soo dhoweyso iyada.
maps-par-clusteranimate: In la daarayo kala guurro siman marka la soo-dhoweynayo iyo marka calaamadaha la kala fidinayo.
maps-par-maxclusterradius: Gacan qabsiga ugu sarreeya ee ay kooxdu dabooli doonto.
maps-googlemaps3-par-clusteraveragecente: In bartamaha koox kasta uu noqdo celceliska dhammaan calaamadaha ku jira kooxda.
maps-googlemaps3-par-clusterminsize: Tirada ugu yar ee calaamadaha ku jiri kara koox ka hor inta calaamadaha la qarinayo oo tiradooda la muujinayo.
semanticmaps-unrecognizeddistance: Qiimaha $1 ma aha masaafad sax ah.
semanticmaps-par-staticlocations: Liis goobaha lagu darayo khariidadda oo ay la socdaan xogta la weydiiyay. Sida ku jirta display_points, waxaad goob kasta ugu dari kartaa cinwaan, sharraxaad iyo astaanta adigoo isticmaalaya calaamadda "~" sidii kala sooce.
semanticmaps-par-showtitle: Muuji cinwaan daaqadda macluumaadka calaamadda ama ha muujin. Daminta tan badanaa waxay faa'iido leedahay marka la isticmaalayo hab raac si loo qaabeeyo waxa ku jira daaqadda macluumaadka.
semanticmaps-par-hidenamespace: Muuji cinwaanka meel magaca ee daaqadda macluumaadka calaamadda
semanticmaps-par-centre: Bartamaha khariidadda. Marka aan la bixin, khariidadda waxay si toos ah u dooran doontaa bartamaha ugu habboon si ay u muujiso dhammaan calaamadaha ku jira khariidadda.
semanticmaps-par-template: tusmada loo isticmaalo qaabaynta waxa ku jira daaqadda macluumaadka.
semanticmaps-par-activeicon: Astaanta la muujinayo halkii laga isticmaali lahaa calaamadda caadiga ah, marka bogga firfircoon uu la mid yahay natiijada weydiinta
semanticmaps-par-pagelabel: Marka loo dejiyo "yes", dhammaan calaamaduhu waxay yeelan doonaan "inlineLabel" oo leh xiriir bogga ay ku jiraan isku-duwayaasha calaamadda
semanticmaps-par-ajaxcoordproperty: Magaca hantida isku duwayaasha ee loo isticmaalo dhisidda weydiinta ajax.
